source.notes: Anchor fixture for #230 auto-extraction. A user→bot turn containing a fact statement must reach the provider's SyncTurn hook so a conservative extraction provider can emit a reviewable durable fact candidate, not auto-write to high-confidence memory.

turn_input.user_content: @bot 注意一下，Cumora 那个项目的 contact 是 yetone，他人在 Isoform，跟 Alma 那条产品线没关系。
turn_input.assistant_content: 记下来：Cumora 关联人是 yetone，组织 Isoform，与 Alma 无产品线关系。

intended_provider_signals: Provider SyncTurn must be invoked with the turn payload.
A conservative extraction provider should emit a reviewable durable fact candidate (not commit it directly).
The fact candidate should retain entity attribution (yetone / Isoform / Alma / Cumora) for later review.
